I will supply my logo, brand colors, and core copy; you’ll translate these assets into a polished site that feels contemporary while remaining easy to navigate. Key tasks include: • Designing a custom homepage to showcase our value proposition at a glance • Building clear interior pages for company information and service overviews • Implementing intuitive navigation, subtle animations, and on-brand typography • Ensuring the entire site is mobile-friendly, SEO-ready, and compatible with major browsers Once the design is approved, please hand over all source files, style guides, and a brief walkthrough so my team can manage small future edits. If you have experience with modern UI frameworks or page builders that streamline maintenance, let me know—flexibility here is welcome.
